text: The major is to train professionals with basic knowledge in geographic information systems and mapping, remote sensing technology, space positioning technology, spatial data processing technology, computer hardware and software applications, computer communication, software development, and other computer-science and technology, who are capable of scientific research or teaching work in the colleges and universities or research institutions, and geographic information systems and related research, development and management in the field of communications network planning and management, urban construction, regional planning, resources, environment, transportation, population, housing, land, infrastructure, planning management and computer applications. The major takes geographic information systems as the foundation, closely linked with computer technology and information technology by giving full play to the advantage in the disciplines of information technology of the university, and it develops itself into an interdisciplinary. Graduate have solid knowledge in geography and cartography with good knowledge of computer science and technology, and strong capacity of geographic information system software applications and development, so that they meet the job requirements in communications, Computer, enterprises information technology, and city digitalization.
